DECISION (Aug 25): the name is Pruva (coined, prove-root).
PROVISIONAL until the Pruva knockout sweep completes — key check in flight: distance from Prudential's PRU-family marks in insurance. Do not buy domains or announce until cleared. pruva.com and pruva.ai looked open at DNS level; registrar check needed.
Retired candidates: Numera (10+ active users incl. TX accounting firm), Certa (blocked — live CERTA marks, Gartner-ranked SaaS), Probo (blocked — YC audit-compliance twin on probo.com), Attest, Proof.

Three mono directions (no green anywhere):
Attest — pure-black theatre, serif at 84px, centered. Most Rogo-like; risk: austere.
Certa — light institutional, split hero with a worksheet card (evidence-forward). Warmest; risk: quiet.
Proof — high-contrast editorial, uppercase grotesk, ruled bands. Most memorable; risk: fashion-forward for carrier buyers.
Main page runs the dark treatment under Numera — mix any name onto any direction.
